subject: design/pipeline-measurement-v2
statement: a **deterministic** git + frozen-artifact reader (`#D-5`), no model and no runtime hook (DINV-1). Per phase it counts the corpus's existing typed anchors — questions = `D-n`, fog = `G-n`, rework = superseded `D-n` + amendment count, defects = review `FND-n`, coverage from the plan matrix, latency from git timestamps — joined to the run record by run/phase id. Because the anchors are identical whichever harness produced the artifact, the efficiency floor is **universal** — it holds on every harness even where spend capture degrades (FR-4). Rejected: runtime skill instrumentation (unreliable on external, prompt-guide harnesses) and LLM quality-judgment (spends model tokens, non-deterministic).
